# README

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/tbep-tech/peptools/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tbep-tech/peptools/actions)
[![pkgdown](https://github.com/tbep-tech/peptools/workflows/pkgdown/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tbep-tech/peptools/actions)

Analysis tools for importing, wrangling, and summarizing indicator data
relevant to the Peconic Estuary Partnersip.

## Installing peptools

Begin by installing the package from
[r-universe](https://tbep-tech.r-universe.dev). The source code is
available on the tbep-tech GitHub group web page:
<https://github.com/tbep-tech/peptools>. Note that peptools only needs
to be installed once, but it needs to be loaded every new R session
(i.e., [`library(peptools)`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)).

``` r

# enable repos
options(repos = c(
    tbeptech = 'https://tbep-tech.r-universe.dev',
    CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))

# install peptools
install.packages('peptools')

# load peptools
library(peptools)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`anlz_attainpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/anlz_attainpep.md)
  : Get attainment categories
- [`anlz_dodlypep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/anlz_dodlypep.md)
  : Analyze daily DO values relative to threshold
- [`anlz_domopep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/anlz_domopep.md)
  : Analyze monthly DO values relative to threshold
- [`anlz_entpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/anlz_entpep.md)
  : Count beach exceedances for enterococcus
- [`anlz_medpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/anlz_medpep.md)
  : Estimate annual medians
- [`beaches`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/beaches.md)
  : Bathing beaches
- [`dodat`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/dodat.md) :
  Dissolved oxygen data for USGS stations
- [`entdat`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/entdat.md) :
  Raw beach pathogen data from Suffolk County
- [`pepseg`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/pepseg.md) :
  Polygon shapefile of segment boundaries
- [`pepstations`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/pepstations.md)
  : Bay stations by segment
- [`peptargets`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/peptargets.md)
  : Bay segment targets
- [`rawdat`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/rawdat.md) :
  Raw water quality data from Suffolk County
- [`read_pepdo()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/read_pepdo.md)
  : Import dissolved oxygen data
- [`read_pepent()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/read_pepent.md)
  : Import raw enterococcus data
- [`read_pepwq()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/read_pepwq.md)
  : Import raw water quality data
- [`show_allthrpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_allthrpep.md)
  : Plot annual water quality value and thresholds for all segments
- [`show_boxpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_boxpep.md)
  : Plot monthly chlorophyll, secchi, or tn values values for a segment
- [`show_domatrix()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_domatrix.md)
  : Create a colorized table for reporting dissolved oxygen data by site
- [`show_entmatrix()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_entmatrix.md)
  : Create a colorized table for beach pathogen exceedances
- [`show_matrixpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_matrixpep.md)
  : Create a colorized table for indicator reporting
- [`show_plotlypep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_plotlypep.md)
  : Plot chlorophyll and secchi data together with matrix outcomes
- [`show_reactablepep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_reactablepep.md)
  : Create reactable table from matrix data
- [`show_segmatrixpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_segmatrixpep.md)
  : Create a colorized table for water quality outcomes and exceedances
  by segment
- [`show_sitemappep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_sitemappep.md)
  : Map water quality data for a selected year
- [`show_thrpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_thrpep.md)
  : Plot annual water quality value and thresholds for a segment
- [`show_wqmatrixpep()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/peptools/reference/show_wqmatrixpep.md)
  : Create a colorized table for chlorophyll or secchi exceedances
